text: Dairihill is a Bosmer noble and the personal steward of Countess Millona Umbranox of Anvil. She is trying to get her cousin promoted to the position of captain of the guard in Anvil. She seems to be upset by the Thieves Guild interfering with the recommendation. S'Krivva of the Thieves Guild is very suspicious of her, even saying: "Dairihill cannot be trusted. You must deliver the letter to Lady Umbranox in person." She also says "The letter is currently in steward Dairihill's desk. She has lied to Lady Umbranox, telling her that the letter has yet to arrive."

Daras Aryon is a Dunmer caravaner who runs the Silt Strider service in Maar Gan. Daras is not involved in any quests. Like all other caravaners, raising his disposition will lead to better travel fares. He wears a set of common clothing and is unarmed.
Dandras Vules is a Dunmer assassin and the leader of the Dark Brotherhood. He can be found in the Moril Manor North Building at Old Mournhold.
Daglin Selarar is a Nord barbarian and member of the Fighters Guild who resides in the Ministry of Truth.
Dagur is a Nord food vendor and the owner of The Frozen Hearth in Winterhold.
Daighre is a Breton miner who can be found outside Left Hand Mine. She has a daughter named Erith, who has a dog named Torom. She owns Daighre's House. She is also a widow.
Dagoth Aladus is a member of the Sixth House faction and, like all Dagoths and members of this faction, is hostile to the Nerevarine.

Dagoth Araynys is a creature found in . It is a member of the Sixth House faction and, like all Dagoths and members of this faction, is hostile to the Nerevarine. Dagoth Araynys is an Ash Vampire, and will weaken Dagoth Ur once defeated.

Dagoth Baler is an Ash Ghoul and a creature found in the Dunmer Stronghold Kogoruhn. He is a member of the Sixth House faction and, like all Dagoths and members of this faction, is hostile to the Nerevarine.
Dagoth Daynil is an Ash Ghoul found at Kogoruhn in . He is a member of the Sixth House faction, and like all faction members, is hostile to the Nerevarine.
Dagoth Delnus an Ash Ghoul, is one of the creatures found at Kogoruhn in . He is a member of the Sixth House faction, and like all Dagoths and members of this faction, is hostile to the Nerevarine.

Dagoth Draven is an ash ghoul and one of the creatures found in Subdun. He is a member of the Sixth House faction, and like all Dagoths and members of this faction, is hostile to the Nerevarine. He is located in Subdun.

Dagoth Endus is one of the ash vampires in who is a member of the Sixth House faction, and like all Dagoths and members of this faction, is hostile to the Nerevarine. He is the brother of Dagoth Ur and the lord of Endusal.
Dagoth Fals is a creature found in . It is a member of the Sixth House faction, and like all Dagoths and members of this faction, is hostile to the Nerevarine.
Dagoth Fandril is a creature found in . It is a member of the Sixth House faction, and like all Dagoths and members of this faction, is hostile to the Nerevarine.
Dagoth Galmis is a creature found in . It is a member of the Sixth House faction, and like all Dagoths and members of this faction, is hostile to the Nerevarine.
Dagoth Garel is an Ascended Sleeper and member of the Sixth House, Like most Dagoths and members of this faction, it is hostile towards the Nerevarine.
Dagoth Gilvoth is one of the creatures found in the lower levels of Dagoth Ur.

Dagoth Goral is a Dagoth located in the unmarked Daedric ruins of Endusal, in Kagrenac's Study. It is a member of the Sixth House faction and, like all Dagoths and members of this faction, is hostile to the Nerevarine.

Dagoth Hlevul is one of the Ascended Sleepers found in . It is a member of the Sixth House faction and, like all Dagoths and members of this faction, it is hostile to the Nerevarine. Killing it will cause several sleepers to awake at the Hlaalu Canton, Suran, and Arano Plantation.
Dagoth Ienas is a creature in . It is a member of the Sixth House faction, and like all Dagoths and members of this faction, is hostile to the Nerevarine.

Dagoth Malan is a member of the Sixth House faction and, like all Dagoths and members of this faction, is hostile to the Nerevarine. Data for Dagoth Malan exists in the construction set, but he is not present in the game, and as such the image is of what he would have looked like.
Dagoth Molos is an Ascended Sleeper found in . It is a member of the Sixth House faction, and like all Dagoths and members of this faction, is hostile to the Nerevarine.
Dagoth Muthes is a creature in . It is a member of the Sixth House faction, and like all Dagoths and members of this faction, is hostile to the Nerevarine.
Dagoth Odros is a humanoid Ash Vampire, and he is member of the Sixth House faction. Like most Dagoths, he is hostile towards the Nerevarine.
Dagoth Ralas an Ash Ghoul and a creature found in Kogoruhn. He is a member of the Sixth House faction and, like all Dagoths and members of this faction, is hostile to the Nerevarine.
Dagoth Soler is a named creature that appears in . It is located in Vemynal. Like all Dagoths, it is hostile towards the Nerevarine.
Dagoth Tanis is a creature found in . It is a member of the Sixth House faction, and like all Dagoths and members of this faction, is hostile to the Nerevarine.

Dagoth Ulen an Ascended Sleeper, is one of the creatures found at Kogoruhn in . He is a member of the Sixth House faction, and like all Dagoths and members of this faction, is hostile to the Nerevarine.
Dagoth Uvil is an Ascended Sleeper found in . He is a member of the Sixth House faction and, like all Dagoths and members of this faction, is hostile to the Nerevarine.
Dagoth Vaner is an Ascended Sleeper of the Sixth House faction and, like all Dagoths and members of this faction, is hostile to the Nerevarine.
Dagoth Velos is a creature found in . It is a member of the Sixth House faction, and like all Dagoths and members of this faction, is hostile to the Nerevarine.
Dagoth Mendras is one of the creatures found in . It is a member of the Sixth House faction, and like all Dagoths and members of this faction, is hostile to the Nerevarine.
Dalami Hlaalu is a Dunmer who resides in Dissapla Mine. She wields a Miner's Pick.
Dalin Norvayne is a Dunmer warrior residing in Onnissiralis. He and his brother Daris Norvayne only appear if the Helm of Tohan plug-in is installed.
Dalnorea Arvel is a Dunmer bandit archer, and resides in the cave of Punsabanit.

Dals Sadri is a Dunmer who resides in the Telvanni Tower in Vivec. He can be found standing behind Mavon Drenim at the top of the Telvanni Tower in the Telvanni Canton. He is able to provide basic information about services and locations within the city of Vivec. Sadri provides no unique information, and is not essential to any quests.
Dalse Adren is an Dunmer gondolier. She can be found on the docks next to the Vivec, Arena Canton.
Dalvus Helothran is a Dunmer commoner who resides in the St. Olms Waist South-Two in Vivec, St. Olms Canton.
Dalyne Arvel is a Dunmer mage and a member of House Telvanni residing in the Telvanni Council House.
Dandynea Rothalen is a Dunmer bandit encountered in the cave of Odibaal.

Danoso Andrano is a Dunmer apothecary owner who resides in the Ald'ruhn Temple in Ald'ruhn. Besides buying and selling ingredients, potions, and apothecary apparatuses, she does not provide any other services. She has 300 for bartering. Once in a while, a random ingredient will be available in her inventory.
Daral Thireloth is a Dunmer who resides in Morrowind's Daedric Shrine of Ald Daedroth, within the Left Wing.
Darane Mencele is a Dunmer Sorcerer and journeyman for the Mages Guild who resides in the Sheogorath dedicated shrine of Bal Fell.
Dareru Omalas is a Dunmer rogue and a member of a bandit gang that has occupied the Dunmer stronghold Andasreth. She can be found on the lower level and is hostile.

Dagoth Tython was a member of House Dagoth. He is related to Dagoth Acra, who was his sister. Originally, he was unaware of his origins and believed that he belonged to House Indoril. He is featured in the "Poison Song" series and is mentioned by name in books four, five, six, and seven.
Dalam Gavyn is a Dunmer Smith and member of the Camonna Tong that resides in the caverns beneath Fatleg's Drop Off in Hla Oad.
Daisy is a dog who belongs to Ganredhel and can be found in her house in Cheydinhal.
Dandsa is a Redguard warrior who was captured by raiders. She is being held captive in the cave of Abernanit near Gnaar Mok. The Nerevarine may be sent to rescue her by the Imperial Legion.
Dahnara is a Khajiit slave who resides in the Dunmer stronghold of Hlormaren.

Dagoth Reler is an Ascended Sleeper in . Unlike most other sleepers, he is capable of speech and may interact with his enemies before attacking. He is a member of the Sixth House and like the other members of the faction, is hostile towards the Nerevarine.
Dagoth Fervas is an Ash Ghoul found at Kogoruhn. He is a member of the Sixth House and, like the rest of the house, is hostile to the Nerevarine.
Darene Bienne is a hostile Breton sorcerer residing in Punabi.
Daracy is a Redguard healer and smuggler who resides in Ashir-Dan.
Dahleena is a Khajiit slave who is being held in Caldera Mine's Slave Shack Two.
Dan-Ru is an Argonian Slave who is being held in Abebaal Egg Mine.
Dantoine Brassac is a Breton priest who resides in the city of Daggerfall. He can be found praying in front of Daggerfall Cathedral.
Danders is a Breton smuggler who can be found dead in the Nerano Ancestral Tomb.
Daria Thenephan is a Breton merchant with her shop just outside the Daggerfall Millworks. She sells a variety of items such as potions and repair kits, cheap to more expensive.
Danus is a Dunmer found in the refugee camp located within the Forgotten Crypts.
Dame Veronica is a Breton who is found near Cambray Pass in Glenumbra. She is at the other end of the pass looking for her husband.
Darcielle Orinth is a Breton, residing near Dwynnarth Ruins, Glenumbra. She is the daughter of Kip Orinth and Marie Orinth.
Daggerfall Patroller is a Breton patroller of the Daggerfall Guard in . He is found on the road outside Daggerfall and will start the quest "Farlivere's Gambit" when spoken to.
Dame Clarique is a Breton Lion Guard who resides in Glenumbra, High Rock. She is assigned to keep an eye on the situation in Eagle's Brook and the captured Red Rook bandit.
Dame Limren Richaut is a Breton knight, residing in Glenumbra, High Rock. She is lost in the catacombs of Cath Bedraud when the Vestige meets her the first time.

Dame Dabienne is a Breton residing in Koeglin Village, Stormhaven. She is found in the stocks in Town Square, being accused for a crime she was not involved in. She is a member of the Knights of the Flame.
Dagnub is an Orsimer residing in Alcaire Castle, Stormhaven. He is found walking behind the Alcaire Keep, delivering supplies.
Dalora is a Dunmer enchanter and a member of the Mages Guild. She is found at their branch in Ebonheart where she sells her wares at her stall, Adjunct Enchanter.
Dame Falhut is a Breton residing in Alcaire Castle, Stormhaven. She is a Knight of the Flame, and is found by the gates. She is later found in her home.
Dame Quirin is a Breton Knight of the Flame residing in Firebrand Keep in Stormhaven. She is found at the bottom of the stairs that leads up to the keep.
Darcy Malveaux is a Breton residing in Wayrest, Stormhaven. He's found in the Cloudy Dregs Inn, not far from the north gate in the city.

Dalac is a Khajiit gatherer residing in Wayrest in Stormhaven. He is one of the workers keeping the city clean and can be found near the Chironasium, close to the Wayrest Mages Guild. A dog keeps him company while he works.
Darasken is an Argonian who resides in Davon's Watch in the region of Stonefalls. He can sometimes be seen talking with Erila Morvayn in the bridge of the city. He cannot be interacted with.
Dalaneth is a Bosmer found in the Bloodtoil Valley. She is the daughter of Mathragor.
Dances-with-Kwama is an Argonian residing in the City Center of Mournhold, Deshaan.
Dajan is a Redguard carpenter residing in the town of Bergama.
Dahla is a Redguard backpack merchant residing in the city of Sentinel. She can be found at her stall, Hollow Drum Haversacks, in the Sentinel Bazaar.
Dalmir Vanos is a Dunmer drunkard, and patron of the Brooding Elf Inn in Quarantine Serk.
Dandrii Dran is a Dunmer residing in Quarantine Serk. She is the cousin of Gorvyn Dran, who went to Stonefalls to warn the people about the Llodos Plague.
Daleez is an Argonian brewer residing in the Tal'Deic Fortress, Deshaan. She can be found at her stall, Better than No Drinks, selling her wares.
Dalodir is a Bosmer woodworker residing in the city of Skywatch, Auridon. He can be found at his store, Deep-Root Woodwork, selling his wares.
Dagila is a Khajiit member of the Mages Guild. She is found at their branch in Dune.
Dagusil Warhammer is a Nord member of the Ebonheart Pact. He is found at their camps in the ruins of Eidolon's Hollow.
Dahari is a Khajiit of the Baandari Clan. She is found at their trading post in Malabal Tor.
Daifa is a Khajiit member of the Subtle Knife gang. She is typically found playing tricks on her friend in the ruins of Thormar, Reaper's March.
Dailirwen is a magus of the Mages Guild found in the hall of Velyn Harbor.
Dajaheel is an officer of the Ebonheart Pact investigating the alliance between the Reachmen and the Worm Cult, in the Vernim Woods.
Dalag-dar is a Khajiit and the leader of the bandit gang who took over the remnants of the Dro-Dara Plantation.
Dalama is a Redguard member of the Fighters Guild found at the Earth Forge, and is involved in a minor capacity during The Prismatic Core.
Dalen Steelhand is a Nord working at The Anvil & Pauldron in Windhelm.
Dalim Herethi is a Dunmer found inside the Tribunal Temple of Mournhold.
Dalin Seri is a Dunmer working at the windmill found in the vicinity of Muth Gnaar.
Dalitra Riverrun is a Nord miner working in the Lost Knife Cave.
Daljari Half-Troll is a Nord warrior overseeing the Trial of the Body at Geirmund's Hall.
Dalmi Dorvayn is a Dunmer member of the Dragonstar Caravan Company. She is found in their local headquarters in Evermore.
Dalsi Sedas is a Dunmer patron of the Brooding Elf Inn in Quarantine Serk.
Damar is a Redguard who resides at the Damar Farmstead in Bangkorai.
Dame Agathe is a Breton member of the Knights of the Flame found in Firebrand Keep.
Dame Alexine is a Breton member of the Knights of the Dragon who got lost in the catacombs of Cath Bedraud.
Dame Frelausa is a Breton member of the Knights of the Flame found in Firebrand Keep.
Dame Jo of the Dragon is a Breton member of the Knights of the Dragon found in the Lion Guard Redoubt. She only appears in this location once Gabrielle Benele has been rescued from Merovec's Folly.
Dame Narine is a Redguard member of the Lion Guard found in the Bonesnap Ruins.
Dame Olivia Laelippe is a Breton member of the Knights of Saint Pelin found in the Bangkorai Garrison.
Dame Valyrie Spenard is a member of the Knights of Saint Pelin investigating the risen dead in the Pelin Graveyard.
Damien is a Redguard who can be found in the central square of Daggerfall, west of Hastien House. He cannot be interacted with.
Damisi is a Dunmer caravaneer found in the entrance to the ruins of the Hel Ra Citadel Trial. She is a colleague of Sallunas, another caravaneer.
Damrina is a Redguard member of the Daggerfall Covenant spying on the Imperial Legion forces found in Razak's Wheel, Bangkorai, in .
Dandea is a Dunmer patron of The Blasted Breton in Alten Corimont.
Dandos is an Altmer found at the Sentinel Palace in Sentinel.
Daneras is wounded Dunmer mage found within the ruins of Taarengrav. He is the assistant of Kireth Vanos.
Danir is a Dunmer member of the Mages Guild. He is found at their branch in Riften.
Daribert Hurier is a Breton member of the Shornhelm City Guard who was attacked by House Montclair soldiers while they were passing through Hinault Farm.
Dariel is a Breton looking for medecinal herbs in the Black Vine Ruins.
Daraneth is a Bosmer mage residing in Southpoint. She is one of the few who managed to remain sane amidst all the chaos occurring in the town.
Daleila is a Redguard member of the Lion Guard residing in the Bangkorai Garrison, Bangkorai.
Dame Gwynnifer is a Breton member of the Knights of Saint Pelin. She is found at the Bangkorai Garrison.

Danual Saklin is a Breton found in Wrothgar. He was a part of the caravan heading towards the city of Orsinium, but got ambushed by the Winterborn. He can be first found near the ambushed caravan, nearby the Merchant's Gate.
Dailalleth is a Bosmer priestess found in the Temple of Ire in the city of Orsinium. She is impossible to interact with.
Dahnadreel is a Redguard guild trader and member of the Thieves Guild, and resides in the Thieves Den within the city of Abah's Landing. She operates a stall named Blue Bottle Trading.
Dar-Zish is an Argonian member of the Thieves Guild found in Thieves Den in Abah's Landing, Hew's Bane.
Daiharri is a Khajiit chef in the Hubalajad Palace in the city of Abah's Landing, Hew's Bane. She can be seen talking to Olmarinn, but can not be directly interacted with.
Dakee-Mota is an Argonian residing in Vulkwasten.He has no unique Dialogue.
Damee is an Argonian traveling merchant. She can be found traveling on the road between Jehanna Docks and Sorrow.
Dagla is a Bosmer traveling merchant. She is found on the road north of Silvenar.
Dalrithor is a Bosmer smith found at the Thalmor Headquarters in Woodhearth. He is a potential assassination target.
Dame Astrimunde Lort is a Breton member of the Knights of Saint Pelin. She is found at their camp at the Martyr's Crossing.
Dame Belline Lonacque is a Breton member of the Knights of Saint Pelin. She is found at their camp at the Martyr's Crossing. She cannot be interacted with.
Dame Epinard of Evermore is a Breton member of the Knights of Saint Pelin. She is found at their camp at the Martyr's Crossing. She cannot be interacted with.
Dame Harbert is a Breton member of the Knights of Saint Pelin. She is found at the Bangkorai Garrison.
Dame Lila Ondre is a Breton member of the Knights of Saint Pelin. She is found at their camp at the Martyr's Crossing. She cannot be interacted with.
Dame Livelle Longis is a Breton member of the Knights of Saint Pelin. She is found at their camp at the Martyr's Crossing.
Dame Lodys Lancarl is a Breton member of the Knights of Saint Pelin. She is found at their camp at the Martyr's Crossing. She cannot be interacted with.
Danders Serene is a Breton found inside the castle in Daggerfall.
Danoso Darethran is a Dunmer member of the Mages Guild. She is found at their branch in Marbruk.
Darane Falavel is a Dunmer laborer and a member of House Hlaalu. She resides in their kinhouse in Narsis, Deshaan.
Dakenibomaz is a Goblin of the Cragkin Tribe. He is found with his fellow tribesmen in the ruins of Qharroa.
Dakee-Kia is an Argonian residing in Tel Mora, on Vvardenfell.

The Dar-m'Athra Shade is an enemy in the Temple to the Divines in Arenthia. This enemy is alongside the Dar-m'Athra Infernal and ready to attack the Vestige to stop them from releasing Akkhuz-ri from the grasp of the Dark Mane.
Damp-Tail is a Khajiit found at the Seaside Sanctuary after the Sea Vipers are driven out.
Dalami Enakenar is a Dunmer scholar and member of the Clockwork Apostles found at the Clockwork Basilica in the Brass Fortress, Clockwork City.
Dandera Ramarys is a Dunmer member of the Clockwork Apostles found at the Clockwork Basilica in the Brass Fortress, Clockwork City.
Dar-m'Athra Predator is a member of the Dro-m'Athra residing in Reaper's March.
Daine Dupare is a Breton found within the Undercroft Great Hall of the Monastery of Serene Harmony in Shimmerene. He has no unique dialogue.
Darezha is a Orsimer residing in Kerbol's Hollow. She can be found wandering between the forge and the merchants' stalls, sometimes walking into Themond's House. She cannot be interacted with.

Dajaleen is an Argonian member of the Bright-Throat Tribe found just outside the Dead-Water Village. She gives the Vestige a quest to investigate and track down the "Skin Taker," a serial torture-killer who has been terrorizing the local Saxhleel.
Dahzini is a Khajiit merchant found in the Rimmen Outlaws Refuge in Rimmen, Northern Elsweyr. She runs The Shadow Market stall.
Daktivus the Enslaver is a Xivkyn in . He may be found patrolling the Imperial City Sewers. He primarily uses ranged and AoE attacks.
Danrok the Insatiable is a Xivkyn in . He may be found patrolling the Imperial City Sewers. He primarily uses melee attacks.
The Dancer is an Imperial commoner in . According to Haskill, the original Sheogorath found the Dancer "most invigorating." She wears a Light Blue Regalia and is her only possession.
Daragaz is a unique daedroth in that resides in Kushtashpi ruins.
Dar-Jasa is an Argonian fisherman found near the docks in Lilmoth.
Daren Hlen is a Dunmer residing in the Dwemer ruins of Nchuleftingth, Vvardenfell. He is part of Neramo's expedition team there. He has a sister Brerayne Hlen.
Dailinir is a Bosmer merchant located south of Vulkwasten, Malabal Tor, in .
Daihjara-la is a Khajiit located in Dreadsail Reef, High Isle and Amenos, in .

The Dark Minion is a Dunmer who can be hired from Rowley Eardwulf for Deepscorn Hollow along with his quarters. He can be found walking about the Hollow, boxing in his room, sleeping, reading books, eating, farming in the venom garden—if they have taken ingredients from there—or praying at the Shrine of Sithis.

Daroso Sethri is a Dunmer knight and a member of House Redoran residing outside the Vivec, Redoran Canton. She provides no services. She has no unique dialogue, but if the Dreamer Prophet is still alive, she will always talk about the killings in Vivec.
Darvasa Vedas is a Dunmer living in Tel Branora, Morrowind. She is a member of House Telvanni.

Dark Seducers, also known as Mazken, are Daedric servants of Sheogorath. They can be found protecting the Shivering Isles region of Dementia. Along with patrolling the streets of Crucible, these Daedric servants involve themselves highly in the protection of New Sheoth, where the Madgod takes up residence.

Davela Hlaren is the proprietor of The Imperial Bridge Inn as well as a Journeyman Hand-to-Hand trainer. Davela also points the Hero in the direction of Helvius Cecia for Master-level Hand to Hand training: "You should consider going to Bruma, and talking with Helvius Cecia. He can teach you more than... well, probably anyone." and "Talk to Helvius Cecia in Bruma. He's your best bet for learning more about hand to hand combat." Davela wears a quilted doublet, tan linens and a pair of doeskin shoes. She also carries a small sum of gold.
Dathman Mochtuis is a Nord smuggler who resides in the Dwemer Ruins of Arkngthand.
Daris Norvayne is a Dunmer warrior residing in Onnissiralis. He and his brother Dalin Norvayne only appear if the Helm of Tohan plug-in is installed.
Darns Tedalen is the Dunmer chief of Sudanit Mine, and a member of House Redoran.
Daroder Helni is a hostile Dunmer assassin and smuggler who resides in Shurinbaal. He is one of two leaders of the bandit group there; the other is Enjine.
Darvala Romothran is a hostile Dunmer archer and slaver who resides in the cave of Zainsipilu.
Darvam Hlaren is the Dunmer proprietor of the Council Club in Ald'ruhn. He is also a member of the Thieves Guild.
Darvynea Hleran is a Dunmer bandit who resides in the cave of Punammu.
Dather Manel is a Dunmer commoner who resides in Ald'ruhn, and can sometimes be found in the Council Club.
Dathus Selvilo is a Dunmer member of House Redoran who resides in the Redoran stronghold of Marandus, in the Molag Amur region.
Davur Githendas is a Dunmer Battlemage residing in Ashinabi.
Hakar is a novice member of the Dawnguard who can only be found in a random encounter.
Dawnguard Vampire Hunter is a radiant member of the Dawnguard. He is randomly encountered if the Dragonborn has joined Harkon's Court.
Daron is a Redguard smith who owns an outside stall in the Great Bazaar in Mournhold.

Darj the Hunter is a Nord initially living in Bleakrock Village. Him and the rest of the residents were forced to leave the island when Daggerfall Covenant forces ransacked the village. Once he safely reached Bal Foyen, he decided to join the Ebonheart Pact like many of the other refugees.
Davina is a Redguard Slave who resides in Tel Aruhn. She can be purchased for 1000 gold and will aid the Nerevarine in battle.
Dayagwen is a Bosmer woodworker who resides in the Alcaire Castle in Stormhaven. She owns a stall, Quiver & Crook, in the Castle's local marketplace.
Davide Retene is a Breton residing in Wayrest, Stormhaven. He's the stablemaster of the Foal's Rest Stables just inside the north gate of the city.
Darvynil Girvu is a Dunmer stablemaster. He sells his horses at the Girvu Stables in Mournhold.
Darynil Savel is a Dunmer brewer residing in the city of Ebonheart, Stonefalls. He he can be found at The Ebony Flask, selling his wares.
Darili is a Dunmer brewer and a member of the Mages Guild. She sells her wares in the guild hall in Eyevea.
Darien is a Breton merchant found in his tent pitched at the crossroads northeast of the Bergama Wayshrine.
Darva is a Dunmer alchemist residing in the city of Riften. She sells her wares at her stall, Scent of Serenity, at the Lakeside Experiments.
Dathlyn is a Dunmer officer of the Ebonheart Pact. She is investigating the presence of Daggerfall Covenant troops in Softloam Cavern.
Davilia Ralas is a Dunmer enchanter first found in her shop Singing Shards, in Davon's Watch. After the Hollow City is restored, she opens the Exceptional Enchants store there.
Dawn-Scale is an Argonian residing at the Davenas Farm, Stonefalls.
Darvala Atrius is an Imperial found at the Dragonstar Arena.
The Dark Mane is a Khajiit Dro-m'Athra who has possessed Mane Akkhuz-ri and in turn, unleashed more of his kind upon the Reaper's March.
Dark Clannfear is a Clannfear that appears in . They are summoned by Keeper Imiril in The Banished Cells II.
Dayarrus is a Xivilai world boss that can be found in Arlimahera's Sanctum.
Dasra is a Redguard fence found in Anvil Outlaws Refuge in Anvil, The Gold Coast.
Davyd Admand is a Breton member of the Evermore City Guard. He is part of the squad sent to investigate the troubles of Murcien's Hamlet. He cannot be interacted with.
Davur Fendyn is a Dunmer member of the Ebonheart Pact. He is found at their camp in Vernim Woods.
Dawnwalker is a Khajiit member of the Mages Guild. She is part of the allied forces found at The Chasm.
Dayna Imayn is a Dunmer banker found in the Foundation's Rising marketplace of Vivec City. She is the owner and proprietor of Lord Vivec's Vault.
Darloc Brae, also known as the Golden Beast and the Beast of Anequina, was a famous Khajiit warrior-king in the First Era.
Dark Witness Clanslayer is a generic Clanslayer appearing in multiple locations, in . They are members of the Dark Witnesses clan.
Dark Witness Bloodcleaver is a generic berserker character residing in several locations in . They are a member of the Dark Witnesses.
Darkfern Digger is a generic Digger residing in several locations in .
Dathidor is a Bosmer member of the Clockwork Apostles residing in Everwound Wellspring, Clockwork City.
Dario was Attrebus Mede's pitcher boy. He accompanied the prince in his missions. He was killed in an ambush along with all of Attrebus' bodyguards.
Dathus Ildram is a Dunmer noble found sleeping in Castle Kvatch's diginitary suite.
Dark Witness Witchman is a generic member of the Dark Witnesses in .
Dark Witness Thornslinger is a generic member of the Dark Witnesses in .
Daydos is one of many cats found in Ishu's House in Riverhold, Northern Elsweyr.
Dark Witness Clanslayer is a generic Clanslayer appearing in multiple locations, in . They are members of the Dark Witnesses clan.
Dark Seducer Warrior is a character in that is a part of the Saints & Seducers Creation Club content.
Dark Seducer Archer is a character in that is a part of the Saints & Seducers Creation Club content.

Decumus Scotti is a fictional character created by the author Waughin Jarth. Scotti was a cowardly man who worked as a clerk at the Atrius Building Commission until 3E 397, and later for Lord Vanech's Building Commission. He is the protagonist in the A Dance in Fire and The Argonian Account novel series. Waughin Jarth claimed that Scotti was based on a real person, with their name changed. Jarth also claimed that a third story featuring Scotti is nearly complete.
Daynila Valas is a Dunmer Miner from the Shulk Egg Mine in Morrowind. She and Sevilo Othan are egg poachers and will attack on sight.

Deetum-Ja is an Argonian commoner living in the town of Harlun's Watch with S'mirra, in their house. In the afternoon, he pulls out his Rake and tends to his vegetable garden with S'mirra. His clothing is mid low class; he wears a Huntsman Vest, a pair of Huntsman Leather Pants and a pair of stitched leather shoes. He also carries a small amount of gold.
Deekus is an Argonian Assassin living by himself at a small campsite near Hela's Folly.
Daynas Valen was a Dunmer treasure hunter and mage, who ventured to and whose corpse rests in Folgunthur; his final search for the The Gauldur Amulet.

Deeja is an Argonian assassin in . Alongside her brother, Jaree-Ra, she leads a criminal gang known as the Blackblood Marauders. She can be found at the docks of the East Empire Company Warehouse near Solitude.

Degaine is a Breton beggar and an injured worker of the Cidhna Mine's smelter living in Markarth. He can often be found in The Warrens or inside the Silver-Blood Inn. Sometimes, he may be found by the market stalls at the city's entrance, or simply wandering around the city.
Daynas Darys is a Dunmer shipmaster who resides on her boat Saucy in Azura's Coast.
Daynasa Telandas is a Dunmer Farmer and member of House Hlaalu who resides on the Arano Plantation.
Daynasa Tharen is a Dunmer bandit who resides in the cave of Odibaal, along with Dandynea Rothalen, Duldresi Senim and Ulvon Uleni.
Daynes Redothril is a Dunmer pawnbroker who resides in Ald'ruhn. His shop is located beside the bookseller.
Daynil Farandas is a Dunmer witchhunter who resides in the Arena of Rotheran.
Dead Meat is a test character in . Dead Meat can be located only through use of the Console commands. They exist primarily as a test character, in a location such as ToddTest.
Degil is a Bosmer and a worshipper of Namira and can be found at Namira's Shrine. When trying to speak to her, she refers to Hjolfrodi the Harrier for information.

Deetwos is an Argonian who resides in Port Hunding, Stros M'Kai. She is spending her days in the Boarding House opposite Port Hunding's Open Marketplace with three others, Jalienna, Uggnath and Vingarion.
Deathfang is a Giant Snake that appears on the beach on the west side of Stros M'Kai, Hammerfell. He is lured out of the water with some special bait and can be hard to defeat.
Degail is an Bosmer sailor residing in the Maormer Invasion Camp. She was captured by Sea Vipers.
Deep-in-Cups is an Argonian who resides in Davon's Watch. He can be found just outside of the Fish Stink tavern.
Dead Courier is a deceased Argonian whose body is located in masse of the fort of Ebrocca in the region of Dementia in the Shivering Isles.
Dedaenil Selas is a Dunmer found at the ponds of Shad Astula.
Defender Furen is a Dunmer of House Redoran member of the Ebonheart Pact. He is stationed in Tal'Deic Fortress.
Daynila Hlas is a Dunmer merchant and part of a group known as the Darkmoon Prowlers. She operates out of the outlaws refuge underneath Rawl'kha. She is the author of Daynila's Corpse-Kebab.

Decanus Vulso is an Imperial guard of a Temple of Mara. Him and his fellow guards Eliana Salvius and Veranus Macatus followed the bandits into their lair at Fort Sphinxmoth. Once inside, they were no match for the sheer number of bandits and were captured.
Dee-Weska is a worshipper of Sanguine found in Sanguine's Demesne.
Deegeeta is an Argonian found in Evermore, in the region of Bangkorai.
Deekonus is an Argonian researcher who was ambushed by Worm Cult agents while exploring the Pinepeak Cavern.
Deepswimmer is a Khajiit member of the Baandari Clan. He can be saved from the troll at Martyr's Crossing.
Deerlus is an Argonian who can be found in the Davon's Watch Outlaws Refuge.
Defender Maera is a Dunmer soldier of House Hlaalu. She is awaiting report concerning the strange attack on one of their caravans that occurred near the ruins of Mzithumz.
Defender Two-Blades is an Imperial member of the Fighters Guild. He is part of the team tasked with destroying the Spider Cult, a group of daedric worshippers faithful to Mephala.
Defender Verilu is a Dunmer of House Hlaalu. She is a member of the Narsis Town Guard.
Defiance is a cat residing at Watch Captain Astanya's Home in Vulkhel Guard.
Deepcrag Miner is a character residing in Deepcrag Den in the region of Deshaan.
Deathknight Stormcrag is a powerful Draugr serving as the boss of Stormcrag Crypt.
Daynea Veri is a Dunmer member of the Ebonheart Pact. She is stationed in Fort Virak.
Deechee-Noo is an Argonian member of the Mages Guild residing in its guildhall in the city of Orsinium.
Daynas Sadrano is a Dunmer guild trader. He operates his kiosk, Beachside Brokers, in Anvil docks.
Dazash is an Khajiit artisan found wandering the streets of Anvil, Gold Coast. He cannot be interacted with.
Deet-Waska is an Argonian beggar who can be encountered at various locations in Shadowfen.
Daynnill-Adran is a Dunmer commoner located in Ald'ruhn on Vvardenfell. He has no unique interaction.
Daynillo Rethul is a Dunmer located in Vivec City on Vvardenfell. She is an apprentice of Divayth Fyr and a member of House Telvanni.
Death Spiders are creatures in . They are summoned by Spiderkith Broodnurses and Ibelgast's Broodnurses in Crypt of Hearts II.
Dead Body, alternately called Dead Hero, is a deceased character found in . There are many variations that can be encountered throughout Vvardenfell. __TOC__
Daynea Rethul is a Dunmer mage of House Telvanni and servant of Divayth Fyr, residing in Tel Fyr on Vvardenfell.
